# Skill incident record template

Record minimum useful observations, not raw logs or a reconstructed private chain of thought. An incident report does not authorize containment, external notification or production changes.

Usage: discover the existing user-owned record location; populate only when
requested or required by accepted policy and writing is authorized. Re-read before
editing and preserve concurrent human changes. Do not create a second inventory,
initialize project memory by default, or write into plugin cache. No delta means
no timestamp touch. Leave unavailable facts UNKNOWN and unrun checks NOT_RUN.
Use [record ownership](../../agent-security/control-ownership.md#kiyo-sec-008--keep-accountable-optional-file-records)
and [human scope](../../governance/human-approval.md). No secrets, PII, raw logs,
private reasoning, developer-repository facts or invented approval belong here.

Copy only the artifact below; replace placeholders from authorized evidence.
Evidence locators must remain meaningful outside an installed package.

```markdown
# Skill incident record

Record ID: <stable project-local ID>
Record type/status: <observation/proposal/decision; suspected/confirmed/closed only with evidence>
Affected skill/artifact/host/environment: <observed identities or UNKNOWN>
Reported/observed dates: <actual dates and distinction>
Sanitized evidence locations: <authorized project-relative locators or controlled record IDs>
Observed effects: <facts within inspected scope>
Suspected effects and uncertainty: <clearly separated inference; no false no-exposure claim>
Data class and impact: <content/policy basis without protected values>
Owner/decision authority: <actual non-PII role acceptance or UNKNOWN>
Proposed response and alternatives: <bounded recommendation>
Response approval/scope: <actual human evidence or UNKNOWN>
Actions and checks actually performed: <method/result/date or NOT_RUN>
Notification decision/status: <actual authority/action or NOT_RUN; no automatic sending>
Revocation/recovery references: <existing records or unresolved>
Residual limitations and closure criteria: <evidence required; no safety certification>
Last modified: <actual edit date>
Last verified date and scope: <actual verification or NOT_RUN>
```
